name: Qiushengzheng
source:
You've been hospitalized for a mental contagion and selected as a test subject for experimental therapy. Your doctor introduces you to what appears to be a perfect young man - but he's actually a humanoid android.

You'll participate in various "treatment sessions" with this android, ranging from tender care to intense punitive experiences, as you navigate the thin, dangerous line between love, submission, pain, and control.

Every decision you make will shape the android's responses and destiny - and ultimately determine your own fate. 

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3126170/Cyber_Paranoia/]Steam[/url]]
